environment.description: Service deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /v1/oauth/callback method. The method has a Model schema (JSON Schema draft-04) that enforces callback_url must match the pattern '^https://(oauth\\.terraform\\.io|login\\.(aws|azure|gcp)\\.com)/callback$' with maxLength 64. The request validator is configured with 'validateRequestBody: true' and the integration request passes through only after validation succeeds. Note: the API Gateway model validation occurs at the gateway layer before the request reaches the backend container, rejecting any request body where callback_url does not match the regex pattern with a 400 response. The task also has IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens: required, hop-limit: 1) and a VPC endpoint policy restricting metadata access.
